scope: Host-only review plan for admitted production-Q32 P19 fixed108; no output conclusions until completion.json.

old_p19_q128.use: Same original P19 fixture/cap/seed rows. Historical Q128 only; never reuse verdict for changed Q32 outputs.

p6_attention_down_bfp8_lofi.use: Matched secondary precision comparator; distinct policy, not all-group full BF16.

all_group_full_bf16_controls.scope_note: Use only rows with exact full prompt ID matches and runtime policy stating all-group BF16/HiFi4. Do not mislabel the prior head-only BF16/HiFi4 panel as full BF16.

row_review_method: Wait for terminal completion.json and confirm exit 0, all108 expected result files, no validation errors, and the run manifest identity before producing final triage.

Join by exact fixture/job identity plus seed, not substring call matching; check generated output file hash, fixture path, prompt-token IDs, chosen continuation IDs, sampling settings, cap, and runtime_precision against the admitted candidate and production Q32 policy.

Read each complete free_running token sequence/text with its exact conditioned prefix. Treat native motif/protocol breakage as affirmative even if it occurs early; only mark cap inconclusive when the output actually hits requested cap and text is still progressing.

Compare new row to exact old P19 Q128 and P6 same-identity rows. Consult full-BF16 only where a surveyed full-policy row has the same seed and exact prompt IDs. Keep policy attribution qualified because Q32 changes geometry and outputs are conditional samples.

For each unresolved row reaching its cap while progressing, note the exact original fixture, seed, current cap, last token IDs/text, output SHA and candidate extended cap. Construct any extension subset solely from these new Q32 findings; retain the extension fixture’s exact original prefix/continuation/sampling/seed and generate fresh provenance and hashes. Exclude natural stops, and do not extend affirmative malformed/native anomalies merely because they hit cap.

conditional_extension_rule.decision_basis: Only new Q32 rows with genuine progressing-cap inconclusive outputs. A candidate from old five-case roster is not automatically included; a newly progressing Q32 row may be added. Extension admission requires a separate reviewed manifest.

trace_tracking_caveat: New fixed108 command records TT_METAL_TRACE_ALLOC_TRACKING=1; historical P19/P6 panels used tracking=0/unset, so compare outcome phenotype and identity, not wall speed.
remaining_scope: No score changes, precision selection, or serving claim; fixed108 is a semantic regression panel only.
